result.summary: The page is mostly visually coherent, but it has a prominent untranslated/broken section title and multiple horizontally clipped elements that make the feed look unfinished.

issues.description: The section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of a user-facing title.
issues.suggestion: Add or correct the localization entry and render the translated section title (for example, "Popular near you").

issues.description: The horizontal category row is clipped at the right edge, leaving part of an additional category pill visible without indicating the full item or scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Use intentional horizontal carousel padding/overflow behavior, or resize the items so the row does not show a truncated pill.

issues.description: The third card in the "Fastest near you" carousel is cut off at the right edge, including its restaurant name and content.
issues.suggestion: Implement the horizontal card carousel with clear partial-peek styling and adequate viewport padding, or adjust card sizing so truncation is intentional and readable.

issues.description: The lower restaurant card is cut off by the bottom navigation area, so only the top of its image is visible in the current viewport.
issues.suggestion: Ensure feed content has sufficient bottom padding above the fixed navigation bar and verify scroll positioning does not obscure cards.
